verdict.rationale: Reclaim's Focus Time and Habits features are explicitly designed to auto-defend recurring blocks and reschedule to the 'next best time' rather than drop them when conflicts arise, and this is corroborated by community users describing habits persisting and commitments being protected. Missing for 10: independent hands-on testing specifically verifying edge cases where defended time is rescheduled rather than dropped, and more detail on manager/team-visibility throttling nuances.
